Title: Azure Site Recovery— PowerShell, WAP Integration

Body.Content: ASR integration with Windows Azure Pack: Azure Site Recovery/Azure Pack integration opens new pipeline for service providers to generate additional revenues from their existing customers by offering Managed Disaster Recovery (DR) services on top of IaaS workloads. PowerShell support for Azure Site Recovery: ASR PowerShell cmdlets, an automatable interface for the Azure Site Recovery, are available today.  This release will opens up opportunities for cloud service providers to extend their own user portal to provide DR operations such as protection and failover. Check out Azure Site Recovery.
